title: RCBA Interact Clubs at UDAAN
summary: The Interact Clubs associated with Rotary Club of Bombay Airport achieved notable success at UDAAN, with students from M. P.
description: The Interact Clubs associated with Rotary Club of Bombay Airport achieved notable success at UDAAN, with students from M. P. Shah English High School and Parle Tilak Vidyalaya receiving recognition across multiple competitions. M. P. Shah English High School secured First Prize with a trophy and cash prize of ₹5,000 in Pantomime, Second Prize with a trophy for a PPT Presentation on Plastic Waste Management, and the Jury’s Special Award in the Freedom of Expression Art Competition. Parle Tilak Vidyalaya received the Young Achievers Award for Excellence in Sports. A total of 30 students registered for UDAAN. President AKS Harsha Mehta, PP Ashmi Parekh and Director Bijal Merchant attended the event. Results of the Drawing Competition were awaited at the time of reporting.
